text: That shooting star isn't a star. Stay, and I'll show you what it really is. Most are crumbs of comet, between a grain of sand and a pea. They hit our air at tens of thousands of miles an hour, and burn up. Every November, the Leonids come from comet Tempel-Tuttle.
